UNTOUCHABILITY CONDEMNED; TEMPLE ENTRY AND COMMON SERVICE
INCREASINGLY CRITICAL OF BIRTH BARRIERS; INTER-CASTE MARRIAGE
INHERITED ALLOCATION CAN PRESERVE CLOSURE DESPITE DENIED RANK

TERM → 'Harijan' is historical usage and contested, not neutral.
